items.zh: 物理学家终于发现了胶球吗？新证据表明是的。

items.title: MIT selected to lead new NSF materials research center
items.summary: The Materials Research Science and Engineering Center unites researchers across disciplines to develop technologies for medical imaging, sustainable metals production, and next-generation electronics.
items.zh: 麻省理工学院被选为 NSF 新材料研究中心的领导者

items.title: Astronomers discover a brand-new type of astrophysical object: A black hole star
items.summary: The mashup of a black hole and an enormous star has never been seen before and could explain the mysterious little red dots often found in deep-space images.
items.zh: 天文学家发现了一种全新的天体物理物体：黑洞星

items.title: Graduate Student Proves a Quantum Uncertainty Principle for Fractals
items.summary: The math, which combines chaos, quantum theory, and infinitely complex fractal structures, has been called a “foundational result.” The post Graduate Student Proves a Quantum Uncertainty Principle for Fractals first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 研究生证明了分形的量子不确定性原理

items.title: Did poop enable the evolution of complex animals?
items.summary: In a recent study, evolution gets even messier than usual.
items.zh: 粪便是否促进了复杂动物的进化？

items.title: Tracking extreme heat by the hour makes climate change seem even worse
items.summary: Hot hours of summer could triple in the coming decades.
items.zh: 按小时追踪极端高温使气候变化看起来更加糟糕
